Below is a tentative class schedule. Since class discussions can sometimes run longer or shorter than expected, please view this as a rough schedule. Please review the course website and Canvas for up-to-date information on what topics and materials we will cover for a particular week or class. I reserve the right to adjust the time allocated to each topic to foster understanding of essential topics and meet the course's learning goals; this may mean we cover fewer or more of the topics presented below.

If Canvas and the website disagree on a date, use this schedule and tell me so we can fix Canvas. Weekly articles and the official submission clock still live on Canvas.

## Meeting-by-meeting

Readings use **CORE *The Economy* 2.0 Macro** where listed, plus **Blanchard 9e** and **Mankiw 9e**. Handouts complement the main readings and do not replace them. Unit notes: [Measurement](notes/01-measurement.qmd) · [Goods](notes/02-goods.qmd) · [Financial](notes/03-financial.qmd) · [IS–LM](notes/04-islm.qmd) · [Labor and Phillips](notes/05-labor-phillips.qmd) · [Growth](notes/06-growth.qmd) · [Open economy](notes/07-open-economy.qmd) · [Debate](notes/08-debate.qmd).
